findings.quote: the mixture was heated to 100°C in a microwave apparatus for 1 h
findings.message: The source describes one microwave-heating event lasting one hour, not a heating step followed by a separate one-hour irradiation step. Retain the temperature and duration in HeatChill and preserve the microwave-heating modality as an unmapped detail.

findings.quote: DME (1.5 mL) was added via a syringe
findings.message: The DME addition is represented, but its syringe delivery method is present only in evidence. Preserve this operational detail in unmapped_actions because Add has no delivery-method field.

findings.quote: filtered through a short plug og Celite
findings.message: The Filter step correctly retains the filtrate but does not structurally preserve filtration through a short Celite plug. Record this detail in unmapped_actions because Filter has no medium field.
